tasks.title: E-mail do kolegi z zagranicy
tasks.prompt:
Piszesz e-mail do kolegi z Anglii, który przyjedzie do Ciebie na wymianę szkolną.

W tekście:
• napisz, jak spędzicie pierwszy dzień
• poinformuj, jaką pogodę zwykle ma Polska w tym miesiącu
• zapytaj o jego dietę lub alergie
• zaproponuj miejsce, które chcesz mu pokazać
bullets: napisz, jak spędzicie pierwszy dzień
poinformuj, jaką pogodę zwykle ma Polska w tym miesiącu
zapytaj o jego dietę lub alergie
zaproponuj miejsce, które chcesz mu pokazać
genreChecklist: Czy odniosłem/am się do wszystkich 4 punktów?
tasks.model:
Hi Ben,
Thanks for your last message. I'm really happy that you are coming to Poland! On your first day we will have lunch at my house and then I'll show you around our school. You can meet my friends there. In October the weather here is usually cool and sometimes rainy, so please bring a warm jacket and an umbrella.
Could you tell me if you are on a special diet or if you have any allergies? My mum is planning the menu and she wants to be sure that you can eat everything. I'd also like to take you to the old town on Saturday because it is beautiful and there are many cafés there. I'm sure you will love it.
Write back soon,
XYZ

tasks.prompt:

• wspomnij o problemie, który się pojawił
• poradź czytelnikom, czy warto tam jechać

wspomnij o problemie, który się pojawił

tasks.model:
Hello everyone!
Last weekend I went to Kraków with my class. We travelled by train, and it took about three hours. The best part of the trip was the visit to Wawel Castle, because the view of the river was fantastic and our guide told us many interesting stories.
Unfortunately, there was a problem on Sunday. Our train was delayed and we waited at the station for an hour, so we were tired when we got home. However, it did not spoil the whole trip.
I think you should definitely go to Kraków if you have time. Book your tickets early and wear comfortable shoes, because you will walk a lot. See you next time!
XYZ

tasks.model:
Hi everyone,
I saw your question about sport after school and I'd like to share my experience. I play basketball twice a week with my school team. We train on Tuesdays and Thursdays and we have a match every second Saturday.
I love this sport because it is fast and I can spend time with my friends. It also helps me forget about homework and stress. Last Saturday we played against another school and we won by four points! I scored six points myself, so I was really proud.
If you want to try it, you can join us next Thursday at 5 p.m. in the school gym. We always need new players, and nobody will laugh at you if you make mistakes. Let me know!
XYZ

tasks.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm writing to complain about a product that I bought from your shop. On 3 October I ordered a pair of wireless headphones, and they arrived two days later.
Unfortunately, the left headphone does not work at all, and the sound in the right one is very quiet. I have charged them several times, but nothing has changed. I have attached a photo of the product and a copy of the receipt.
Could you tell me whether I can have my money back or get a new pair? I would prefer a new pair, but I will accept a refund, too. I would be grateful if you could answer as soon as possible, because I need the headphones for school.
Yours faithfully,
XYZ

tasks.model:
Hi, readers!
Today I want to write about my hobby, which is photography. I take pictures of nature, mostly in the forest near my house. I started three years ago when my dad gave me his old camera.
My biggest success was last spring, when my photo of a fox won a school competition. I was very surprised, because I didn't think it was good enough. The prize was a small tripod, which I use every day now.
If you would like to start, you don't need an expensive camera. Your phone is enough. Go for a walk, look around and take pictures of things that you like. After some time you will notice small details that you have never seen before. Good luck!
XYZ

Hi Anna,
I hope you are well. I'm writing because our class is going to the cinema next Saturday at 6 p.m., and I'd love you to come with us. We want to see the new science fiction film, which has great reviews.
I chose this film because many people in our class like this genre and the story is supposed to be exciting. I've also heard that the special effects are amazing.
Would you prefer to sit in the front or at the back? And do you want to meet in front of the cinema or go there together from school? Please let me know by Friday so that I can book the tickets.
See you soon,
XYZ
